target.title: Expose stale plugin runtime symlink doctor lint findings
target.body:
## Summary
- expose stale global plugin-runtime symlinks as default-disabled `core/doctor/stale-plugin-runtime-symlinks` lint findings
- reuse the existing plugin-runtime symlink detector and map stale links to structured warnings
- keep real unlinking in the existing `doctor --fix` cleanup path

## Contract / compatibility
- No public SDK, plugin manifest, config schema, persisted data-model, or plugin contract changes.
- Default `doctor --lint` behavior is unchanged because the check is `defaultEnabled: false`; `--only core/doctor/stale-plugin-runtime-symlinks` and `--all` can select it.
- Lint is read-only. Existing repair code remains the owner for removing stale symlinks.

## Validation
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/commands/doctor/shared/plugin-runtime-symlinks.ts src/commands/doctor/shared/plugin-runtime-symlinks.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint src/commands/doctor/shared/plugin-runtime-symlinks.ts src/commands/doctor/shared/plugin-runtime-symlinks.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/doctor/shared/plugin-runtime-symlinks.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo`
- `node scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs --check`
- `node scripts/sync-plugin-sdk-exports.mjs --check`
- `git diff --check`

## Real behavior proof

Behavior or issue addressed:
Stale global `node_modules` symlinks that still point at pruned `plugin-runtime-deps` directories can now be surfaced as structured Doctor lint warnings when explicitly selected, without unlinking them from lint.

Real environment tested:
WSL Ubuntu 24.04 source checkout at this PR head, hydrated with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`; source harness using real temporary directories and POSIX symlinks shaped like an installed OpenClaw package under `prefix/lib/node_modules/openclaw`.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. Created a temp `prefix/lib/node_modules/openclaw` package root and a stale `@slack/web-api` symlink under the containing `node_modules` directory.
2. Pointed that symlink at a missing target under a temp `state/plugin-runtime-deps/...` path.
3. Ran `node --import tsx --input-type=module` to import `collectStalePluginRuntimeSymlinkHealthFindings({ packageRoot })` from this checkout.
4. Verified the detector returned one warning and the symlink still existed after detection.

Evidence after fix:
```json
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "checkId": "core/doctor/stale-plugin-runtime-symlinks",
      "severity": "warning",
      "message": "Stale plugin-runtime symlink @slack/web-api points at /tmp/tmp.04y5zFaxYP/state/plugin-runtime-deps/openclaw-slack/node_modules/@slack/web-api.",
      "path": "/tmp/tmp.04y5zFaxYP/prefix/lib/node_modules/@slack/web-api",
      "target": "/tmp/tmp.04y5zFaxYP/prefix/lib/node_modules/@slack/web-api",
      "requirement": "stale-plugin-runtime-symlink-removed",
      "fixHint": "Run `openclaw doctor --fix` to remove stale plugin-runtime symlinks."
    }
  ],
  "linkStillExists": true
}
```

Additional focused regression proof verifies default lint skips this default-disabled check, `--only core/doctor/stale-plugin-runtime-symlinks` runs it, and detection is not invoked unless the check is explicitly selected.

Observed result after fix:
The production detector emitted one structured warning for the stale symlink and did not remove the symlink. The contribution-level lint selection regression confirms the check remains opt-in by default.

What was not tested:
No live package install/update flow was tested; this slice only exposes read-only lint for stale symlinks already handled by the existing `doctor --fix` cleanup path.
